text: Image variants after rectification: archive, detail, normal, thumb
description: From the rectified archive master (JPEG q90, private in R2 + local copy) derive web JPEGs, longest side capped, never upscaled: detail 2560/q80, normal 1280/q75, thumb 384/q70. Config in shared/image-variants.ts; its hash is stored per painting (variants_version), and `pnpm images:regen [--force]` regenerates outdated variants from the archive.

status.comment: Verified locally 2026-11-02: 1200x800 archive → detail/normal 1200x800 (no upscale), thumb 384x256; archive 404 on public /img; images:regen skipped up-to-date (0/2), regenerated one with an outdated variants_version (1/2), --force did 2/2.
